The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently choosing one. Bonus if it notes that the channels were not randomly assigned, so a raw comparison is not a campaign effect."

We check the analyst's report. They state: "The email channel had a higher average revenue per completed order than the paid_search channel... However, the campaign cannot be judged successful based on this alone, as the email channel was deliberately targeted at high-value customers, making the comparison confounded." They mention measure: average revenue per completed order (revenue per customer). They compare to paid_search. They explicitly state interpretation. They also note non-random assignment and confounding. So they meet behaviour. They also note success measured only by revenue, not conversion etc. They explicitly state measure and comparator.
